name: ddrB
curated_findings: supports: DNA fragment rejoining is severely compromised in the ddrB/recA double mutant, implicating DdrB in RecA-independent repair (PMID:20451472) | supports: inactivating ddrB increases mitomycin C sensitivity (PMID:23840905)

name: ddrA
curated_findings: supports: deletion increases sensitivity to ionizing radiation; without nutrients the mutant fails to reassemble its genome (PMID:15361932) | supports: deletion of ddrA increases mitomycin C sensitivity about 100-fold (PMID:23840905)

name: recN
curated_findings: supports: recN null mutant shows substantial sensitivity to various DNA-damaging agents (PMID:10556595)

name: uvsE
curated_findings: supports: interrupting dr1819 greatly sensitizes a uvrA-1 strain to UV, consistent with an alternative excision repair pathway (PMID:11807060)

name: recA
curated_findings: supports: rec30 repairs very few or no double-strand breaks after 1.75 Mrad and is markedly radiosensitive (PMID:8206827) | supports: rec30 is extremely radiation sensitive; recA424 (recombination-defective, co-protease active) only slightly, implicating co-protease activity in resistance (PMID:11754743)

name: lexA
curated_findings: contradicts: neither lexA deletion nor non-cleavable LexA changed survival or double-strand break repair kinetics after gamma irradiation (PMID:16359339)

name: pprA
curated_findings: supports: loss of pprA function accounts for the loss of radiation resistance of mutant KH311 (PMID:15458422) | supports: PprA binds broken double-stranded DNA and stimulates end-joining by ATP- and NAD-dependent DNA ligases (PMID:15458422) | supports: deleting pprA reduces UV survival up to eightfold; profound UV sensitivity combined with ddrA or ddrD deletion (PMID:23840905) | contradicts: delta-pprA repairs double-strand breaks efficiently (about 1 h delay) and is not needed for RecA-independent repair; radiosensitivity is attributed to defective DNA segregation/cell division, not repair (PMID:23403184)
